Ben 10 - Omniverse 2.name: Ben 10: Omniverse 2
Ben 10 - Omniverse 2.summary:
Wii port of Ben 10: Omniverse 2

Ben 10: Omniverse 2 is an 3D action game based on the Ben 10: Omniverse animated series. Emperor Millious of the Incursean empire has exiled Ben to space. After being rescued by Azmuth the both of them end up on a Incursean cruiser on course for Earth.

The player takes control of Ben and can transform in to a multitude of aliens that vary in size, and abilities. Alien forms can be upgraded and more powerful attacks can be unlocked by collecting green watch symbols.

Canada Hunt.name: Canada Hunt
Canada Hunt.summary: Canada Hunt is a fully three-dimensional hunting simulation game. More realistic than any other hunting game, it features lifelike animals in their natural environments. Takes you through specialized training and bonus features that players of all levels, from the beginner to the most hardcore hunter, will enjoy. Includes ultra-realistic: Whitetail Deer, Rocky Mountain Elk, Wild Turkeys, and Critter Cam.

Counter Force.name: Counter Force
Counter Force.summary: A Wii port of the on-rails shooter Ex Zeus.

Let's Paint.name: Let's Paint
Let's Paint.summary:
Let's Paint let's you explore your creative side by giving you the tools to paint your own masterpiece. 
 
In Paint Mode, choose Freestyle to draw and paint your very own piece of art or color some pages from the Coloring Book. You can also use the I Play Mode, or play a mini-game with a friend.

Monopoly Collection.name: Monopoly Collection
Monopoly Collection.summary: 2 games in 1! Both the Original Monopoly and Monopoly Streets.

PokePark 2 - Wonders Beyond.name: PokéPark 2: Wonders Beyond
PokePark 2 - Wonders Beyond.summary: Sequel to PokéPark Wii: Pikachu's Adventure. As in the previous game you play as Pikachu, traveling around and encountering other Pokémon.

Puzzle Series Vol. 1 - Sudoku.name: Puzzle Series Vol. 1: Sudoku
Puzzle Series Vol. 1 - Sudoku.summary: "Sudoku", which is a hot topic all over the world, is finally coming to Wii. It is also interesting to play by choosing from 4 difficulty levels by yourself, and to challenge how many questions you can clear within the time limit. In addition, you can register up to 100 questions, so you can copy the questions in the newspaper and play with them, or you can create your own original questions. In addition, the two-player battle mode is also fulfilling. In "Point Battle", you can use the item panel, and you can play while bargaining, such as "chain" and "quick placement". In "speed battle", you compete for which one has cleared many problems in the same time. Of course, there is plenty of support for beginners. You can proceed while learning the rules in the hands-on tutorial.
